name: FrenchModelVariant648_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/image9840_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it clears the 0xF68-byte work area, packs the texture at the image's first data name and selects the 0x10-byte command row indexed directly by the request (delay, radius, length, two end radii and two RGB triples), activating two primary parts, a secondary shell and triangle bursts, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-image9840-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-631 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/variant631us_entry.c (and japanese/model_variant/variant631us_entry.c), which add the E_DATA work-size printf, and bind the data names 0x28 higher. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
